title: Preserve or explicitly refuse provider association for tests in a distinct linked worktree
outcome: A genuine test command issued with an explicit cwd in a distinct linked worktree does not silently lose provider-to-launcher/native-completion association because the runner session works in the main checkout.
acceptance: A disposable behavioral regression uses the real provider observation, registration, artifact refresh and native-completion owners with the session workdir at the main root, explicit command cwd in a distinct linked worktree and Engram disabled; it exposes the current silent empty-root/artifactless association failure before the production fix.

For a genuine test command whose explicit cwd is inside a linked worktree of the session's own repository (the documented fresh-worktree runner flow), provider/registration/artifact/native-completion association succeeds with the original runtime and request identity, and a native completion is produced. Only a start placement outside any worktree of the session's repository may instead refuse, and it then exposes a bounded readable reason at that boundary. In no case is a silent empty root, fabricated completion or credit produced, and original custody, source and qualification guards remain intact.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree that lands.
